parsed.name: CLARIOstar多功能酶标仪
parsed.description: CLARIOstar 是一款多功能微孔板读板仪，可对微孔板样品进行吸光度、荧光和发光检测，常用于生化分析、细胞实验、药物筛选和其他高通量实验。
parsed.description_en: The CLARIOstar is a multimode microplate reader used to measure absorbance, fluorescence, and luminescence in microplate samples. It is commonly used for biochemical assays, cell-based experiments, drug screening, and other high-throughput laboratory workflows.
